primary_endpoint: Changes in MRI-PDFF and histologic features of MASH after bariatric intervention.
efficacy_outcome: MRI-PDFF showed a 72% reduction at 6 months (ratio of means, 0.28); NAS decreased by 60% at 3–6 months, 40% at 12–24 months, and 50% at 36–60 months. Histologic features also improved, including significant fibrosis (≥F2), reduced by 18% at 12–24 months and 17% at 36–60 months.
